verdict.rationale: Nix's own docs describe transparent build caching through binary caches that skip source builds by fetching pre-built binaries (nix-docs-36, nix-docs-52). nix-shell reuses dependencies already in the local Nix store and only builds or downloads what is missing (nix-docs-2). Nix also supports easy transfer of software environments between computers (nix-docs-53), which hints at reuse without network access. missing for 10: a documented CI-specific cache-restore setup (e.g., caching the Nix store between CI runs), explicit documentation of offline-capable installs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI install speed.
